name: Weekly Back in Stock demand and revenue report for Shopware

parameters.content:
## Weekly Back in Stock demand and revenue report for Shopware

### How it works
Every Monday the workflow collects the data of the **Novastrix Back in Stock** plugin: how many customers wait for which out-of-stock products, how much revenue the notifications have brought back, and which notifications failed. It emails a short HTML report so purchasing knows what to reorder first. Optionally it retries the failed notifications, so customers whose email bounced temporarily still hear about the restock.

### Setup
1. Self-hosted n8n only for now: install the community node **n8n-nodes-novastrix-shopware** (tested with 0.2.0, n8n 2.48 and 3.x, Shopware 6.7) via **Settings > Community nodes**. [Installation guide](https://github.com/Breadchicken/n8n-nodes-novastrix-shopware#installation)
2. In Shopware, create an integration under **Settings > System > Integrations** (access to the Back in Stock plugin) and add its access key ID and secret as a **Shopware Admin API** credential.
3. Install the [Novastrix Back in Stock](https://novastrix.com/shopware) plugin in Shopware.
4. Connect a **Gmail** credential.
5. In **Configuration**, set the report recipient, how many products to list and whether failed notifications are retried. Run the workflow once and check the email.

### Customization
Change the schedule, send the report to Slack instead of email, or add the stock of each product with a Shopware **Get Many Products** node.

## Schedule and settings
Runs every Monday at 8:00. Set the recipient and options in Configuration.

## Collect the plugin data
Demand per product, recovered revenue and failed notifications.

## Retry failed notifications
Only when enabled in Configuration.

## Send the report
One HTML email per week.

## Emails customers
Each retry sends it again.
